env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A zero-copy conversion ends at its own closing parenthesis, whatever
# follows it: an operator, an index, a comment. The module runs natively,
# ejects, and the ejected module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2
# from $UPROOT1272 and prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^hello! <hello> 6 101 hello$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/zerocopyoperand

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	s := "hello"
	var b const []byte = const []byte(s)
	t := string(b) + "!"
	u := "<" + string(b) + ">"
	n := len(string(b)) + 1
	c := string(b)[1]
	d := string(b) // comment after a conversion
	fmt.Println(t, u, n, c, d)
}
